snippet.title: Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault | Early Access Date Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
🎒Wishlist #Moonligter 2: The Endless Vault now: https://re.11bits.com/8ab1ee 

Much like Will’s long road back, crafting #Moonlighter 2 into its final form takes time. That’s why we’re inviting players to get an early taste of the journey through Early Access.

From day one, explore three biomes with unique enemies, gather 120+ relics to sell, and run your shop your way. Discover most of the story while mastering a refined combat system with four weapons, nearly 100 perks, and smoother gameplay ⚔️💚
